formal_statement: ∀ (B : Language Bool) (p : Polynomial ℕ) (n : ℕ) (T : List (Option Bool)) (c : List Bool), B ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.SIZE (fun m : ℕ => p.eval m) → (∀ i : List Bool, i.length = n → (i ++ c ∈ B ↔ T.getD (List.foldr (fun (b : Bool) (a : ℕ) => 2 * a + (if b = true then 1 else 0)) 0 i) none = some true)) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide (T.getD (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.tableIndex x) none = some true)) (p.eval (n + c.length) + 1)
plain_statement: If a language B has circuits of size p and, with the string c appended, B answers on index i whether entry i of the partial table T is the defined value 1, then the zero completion of T has a circuit of size p(n + |c|) + 1. From L-meta-018 and L-meta-019. Needed by L-meta-016.
title: Zero completion from a circuit family for the bit language
